functional.summary: Story-level functional check for multi-plant, run LIVE in the browser on http://127.0.0.1:3001 against the story worktree's own servers (frontend restarted after verify's build, backend on 4001, Postgres warehouse on 5433) as the seeded admin who holds all 31 plants. Every behaviour the story promises was exercised end to end: all 31 plants offered, a plant without budget renders dashes on screen, in the drill and in the export, DUB is unchanged, provisional labels are marked, and the selectors depend on each other.
manual_validation_steps: Selector menu (browser, /mis-reports): the Plant select lists 31 options; DUB reads 'Agri - Nursery - DUB' with no mark and the other 30 carry the plain-text suffix '— Provisional labels'.

Dependent selectors (browser): picking H.O fills Department=Corporate and Function=Office and leaves H.O as the only plant; picking Department=Agriculture leaves Function=Nursery only, the Plant menu at the 14 nurseries, and clears a prior H.O pick.

H.O statement (browser, July 2026): header 'Office — Corporate - Office - H.O' with the 'Provisional labels' mark; every Budget, Roll-over and % cell is a dash carrying the accessible label 'Budget not loaded for this plant' (636 labelled cells); Actuals populate (Manpower Expenses ₹99,30,377, Admin Expenses ₹1,39,25,575); Grand total Actual ₹2,38,55,952 with dashes beside it.

H.O drill (browser): clicking the Manpower Expenses Actual opens the drill-down with 5 lines (Salaries ₹93,19,160, Overtime ₹0, Staff Welfare ₹4,19,092, Recruitment ₹46,200, Training ₹1,45,925), Budget and % dashed on every line, footer Total ₹99,30,377 with exact ₹99,30,376.88 and dashed Budget and %.

H.O export (browser session, POST /api/mis/statement/export with the page's CSRF token): 200, content type application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 12,231 bytes starting with the PK zip signature, filename financial-mis-corporate-office-h-o-2026-07-01-to-2026-07-01.xlsx. The in-page Download Excel button issued the same request and received 200.
CK statement (browser, July 2026): header 'Nursery — Agriculture - Nursery - CK' with the provisional mark; 642 dashed budget cells; Grand total Actual ₹85,46,436.

DUB statement (browser, July 2026): header 'Nursery — Agri - Nursery - DUB' with NO provisional mark; zero 'Budget not loaded' cells; Grand total Budget ₹1,00,50,136, Actual ₹1,15,12,712, 114.6% (YTD ₹2,59,13,990 / ₹1,15,12,712 / 44.4%); leaf 7.1 Nursery labour Primary Budget ₹81,023, Actual ₹41,300, 51% — identical to the shipped statement before this story.
residual_risks: Only DUB has a budget in the PoC, so the loaded state is exercised by one plant and the not-loaded state by thirty; a second plant budget would exercise both on the same screen (decision 0036).
The seeded admin holds all 31 plants, so Ask statement questions answer 'not supported' for that user (decision 0037); a single-plant demo user is the workaround.
